description: Board picture squashes vertically to a thin sliver (f5865-f5867) and re-expands (f5868-f5869) as a different painterly picture (deathbed with praying woman); narrator and room static. Squash-and-swap picture transition.
Water glass icon appears at right at f5946 and moves leftward to sit beside "drinks ?" by ~f5949; text static.
Wooden mug falls/slides in from upper right (f5971-f5973) and settles beside bread by f5974; man head tilts/eye direction changes.
Man head tilt and gaze shift across tiles (looking down-right at f5973-f5974, forward by f5976-f5977).
Speech bubble appears small and greyed at f6153, becomes full black outline and larger by f6155 with text "looks fine to me"; stays through f6159.
Bubble opacity ramps up over about f6153-f6155 (grey to black); text appears with it.
Background and overlays shift/scale slightly across tiles (town and trees move a few px); labels drift down/right, "parasites" label fades.
"parasites" label and arrow dim progressively toward f6303.
Label "diarrhea" and brown blob icon shrink/dim toward f6367 while the half-submerged man sinks lower in frame.
Floating man moves slightly downward/bobs across tiles.
Board picture squash-and-expand: thin sliver at f6569-f6570, expands to parchment panel with pot at f6571-f6572; picture swap.
Two purple germ icons appear above pot and rise slightly; steam wisps present by f6572.
Glass beer mug and wooden mug sprites enter from sides in alternating tiles (f6625-f6627); "middle ages" sign appears at top at f6630-f6631. Tiles overlap in the strip, ordering partly ambiguous.
Alternation between glass-mug and wooden-mug images between adjacent tiles could be a rapid compare/cut; cannot be separated from tile overlap.
Alternating views of glass mug "5% alcohol" and wooden mug "~1% alcohol" across f6707-f6710; ordering partly ambiguous due to tile overlap.
Glass mug and labels leave; by f6711 only the wooden mug remains centred (f6711-f6714 static).
Man holds mug on extended arm; head tilt and mouth shape change; mug/arm shifts slightly up/down across tiles.
Mug is gone; arm extended, head tilts and mouth opens/closes; slight whole-scene drift.
Sweat drop on forehead fades by f7245; another drop appears by the beard at f7249.
Spear grows/pierces into torso from f7246 and is nearly full length by f7249.
Thought bubble with bowl fades in at upper right from f7324, bowl progressively darker by f7331; man gaze moves upward.
Man and spear shift left and shrink across tiles (zoom-out / reposition), most visible f7324 to f7328.
Wooden signpost descends from top: pole only at f7522-f7523, sign board visible at f7524, settled on table by f7525 with slight vertical bobbing to f7529.
